sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, the 116th Congress has been sworn in.
sentences.zh: 今天，第116届国会已经宣誓就职。

sentences.en: And with it, Democrats take control of the House and Nancy
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是，民主党夺回了众议院的控制权，南希·

sentences.en: Pelosi retakes her position as its leader.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西重新担任议长。

sentences.en: The scene on the Hill as it happened.
sentences.zh: 这是国会山现场发生的一幕。

sentences.en: It's Friday,
sentences.zh: 今天是周五，

sentences.en: January 4th.
sentences.zh: 1月4日。

sentences.en: Senate press gallery, we're going to get tidies?
sentences.zh: 参议院新闻发布厅，我们要去整理一下吗？

sentences.en: Checking at that desk there.
sentences.zh: 检查一下那张桌子。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So it's Thursday morning, and we're inside the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在是周四上午，我们身处美国

sentences.en: Capitol.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦。

sentences.en: We are here because this is the day when Democrats take the majority in the House.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以在这里，是因为今天是民主党在众议院获得多数席位的日子。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi reclaims the speakership and divided government begins.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西重掌议长之位，分裂政府的局面开始了。

sentences.en: And we're going to go talk to my colleague, Julie Davis, who is covering this from morning until night.
sentences.zh: 我们要去采访我的同事朱莉·戴维斯，她从早到晚都在报道这件事。

sentences.en: So Julie says she's over in the NYT hovel.
sentences.zh: 朱莉说她在《纽约时报》的“窝棚”里。

sentences.en: Should we just go try to find it and say hi?
sentences.zh: 我们要不要去找找看，打个招呼？

sentences.en: What do you think a hovel is?
sentences.zh: 你觉得什么是“窝棚”？

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, it's just a decrepit, unpolished home.
sentences.zh: 哦，我是说，那只是一个破旧、简陋的地方。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Julie is a hovel.
sentences.zh: 朱莉就在“窝棚”里。

sentences.en: It is a hovel.
sentences.zh: 这确实是个窝棚。

sentences.en: It's kind of small.
sentences.zh: 有点小。

sentences.en: I think we should note for listeners that the New York Times Congressional Bureau is within sound distance of flushing toilets.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该提醒听众，《纽约时报》国会分社就在冲水马桶的隔音范围内。

sentences.en: That's the sound you're hearing.
sentences.zh: 那就是你听到的声音。

sentences.en: And also the Senate gavel.
sentences.zh: 还有参议院的木槌声。

sentences.en: Flushing toilets,
sentences.zh: 冲水马桶，

sentences.en: Senate gavel.
sentences.zh: 参议院木槌声。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: So, Julie, what's happening today?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，今天发生了什么？

sentences.en: So it's a big historic day.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大的历史性日子。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi will be elected speaker to reclaim the gavel as the first woman to hold that poSt. And you have 100
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西将作为首位担任此职的女性被选为议长，重新掌握木槌。而且你有100位

sentences.en: new members of the House of Representatives, 66 of them Democrats, 44 Republicans, including the most diverse gender and racially diverse class in history.
sentences.zh: 众议院新成员，其中66位是民主党人，44位是共和党人，包括历史上性别和种族最多元化的一届。

sentences.en: You have the first Muslim woman.
sentences.zh: 你有第一位穆斯林女性议员。

sentences.en: You're going to see the first hijab being worn on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 你将看到第一条希贾布头巾出现在众议院大厅。

sentences.en: You have the first Native American woman.
sentences.zh: 你有第一位美洲原住民女性议员。

sentences.en: And they're all going to be sworn in and take their places on the House floor after having stood up and voted for Pelosi for speaker.
sentences.zh: 她们都将宣誓就职，并在投票支持佩洛西担任议长后，在众议院大厅就座。

sentences.en: So we should go down there.
sentences.zh: 我们应该去那里看看。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we should have reporters assembled waiting for Pelosi to emerge, all the photographers, for her big close up, her big moment.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们应该有记者聚集在那里等待佩洛西出现，还有所有的摄影师，为了她的大特写，她的大时刻。

sentences.en: You know, it's been a while since the opening of Congress has had a lot of sort of new elements to it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，国会开幕已经很久没有出现这么多新元素了。

sentences.en: You know, it's usually these things are pretty standard affairs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，通常这些事情都是相当标准的流程。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I don't think I've ever seen this many people in this hall before.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我以前在这个大厅里见过这么多人。

sentences.en: Is that a press conference?
sentences.zh: 那是新闻发布会吗？

sentences.en: So this is the House Press Gallery.
sentences.zh: 这是众议院新闻发布厅。

sentences.en: This is the House Press Gallery, yes.
sentences.zh: 这是众议院新闻发布厅，没错。

sentences.en: Let's go in.
sentences.zh: 我们进去吧。

sentences.en: This is really cool.
sentences.zh: 这真的很酷。

sentences.en: Are you familiar with the recording rules in here?
sentences.zh: 你熟悉这里的录音规则吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Do you have a press pass?
sentences.zh: 你有记者证吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we're from New York.
sentences.zh: 有，我们来自纽约。

sentences.en: So you can take audio in the chamber if it's for your note-taking purposes only.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你只是为了做笔记，可以在议会厅内录音。

sentences.en: It can't be for rebroadcaSt. And you can't record anything that happens in here for broadcaSt.
sentences.zh: 但不能用于转播。而且你不能录制这里发生的任何用于广播的内容。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So we are going to let you go and check back in with you later in the day.
sentences.zh: 那我们就先让你忙，稍后再和你联系。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Sounds great.
sentences.zh: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: I'm going to head in there and see what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我要进去看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Talk to you soon.
sentences.zh: 回头聊。

sentences.en: Do you owe you a free now?
sentences.zh: 你现在有空吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.en: Should we go someplace else?
sentences.zh: 我们要去别的地方吗？

sentences.en: Why don't we just go here?
sentences.zh: 为什么不直接去这里呢？

sentences.en: Crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: So, Julie, what was it like once you got inside the chamber?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，你进入议会厅后感觉如何？

sentences.en: So, it was very loud and it was hot because us reporters were sort of all packed into the gallery
sentences.zh: 非常吵，而且很热，因为我们记者都挤在记者席里，

sentences.en: and the visitors gallery was all full of people as well, family members and friends and supporters.
sentences.zh: 访客席也坐满了人，包括家人、朋友和支持者。

sentences.en: And then the well of the house, the actual floor, was completely filled with members and children because they were allowed to bring kids, I think, 12 and under.
sentences.zh: 众议院的中心，也就是实际的议事厅，挤满了议员和孩子们，因为他们被允许带12岁及以下的孩子进入。

sentences.en: So there were lots of babies being bounced around, lots of kids running around in their, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以到处都是蹦蹦跳跳的婴儿，很多孩子穿着他们，你知道的，

sentences.en: fancy clothes and they were all sort of greeting each other for the members who had been there before and high-fiving each other for the ones who were new.
sentences.zh: 漂亮的衣服跑来跑去，他们都在互相问候，老议员们互相击掌，新议员们也一样。

sentences.en: After they got called to order, there was a prayer.
sentences.zh: 在宣布开会后，进行了一次祈祷。

sentences.en: Receive now this prayer, O Lord.
sentences.zh: 主啊，请接受这份祈祷。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: And the Pledge of Allegiance.
sentences.zh: 以及效忠誓词。

sentences.en: I pledge allegiance to the flag.
sentences.zh: 我宣誓效忠国旗。

sentences.en: And then what they did was they started something called the Call of the State.
sentences.zh: 然后他们开始了一项叫做“州名点名”的程序。

sentences.en: The representatives-elect will record their presence by electronic device and their names will be reported in alphabetical order by state.
sentences.zh: 候任众议员将通过电子设备记录他们的出席情况，他们的名字将按州名以字母顺序报告。

sentences.en: They have to convene the House, essentially.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上必须召集众议院。

sentences.en: They have to get everyone there because they're going to elect the leadership.
sentences.zh: 他们必须让所有人都到场，因为他们要选举领导层。

sentences.en: Representatives-elect will have a minimum of 15 minutes to record their presence by electronic device.
sentences.zh: 候任众议员将至少有15分钟的时间通过电子设备记录他们的出席情况。

sentences.en: The lights dim a bit and the electronic boards turn on.
sentences.zh: 灯光稍微变暗，电子显示屏亮起。

sentences.en: All the names of the members of Congress appear on the wall.
sentences.zh: 所有国会议员的名字都出现在墙上。

sentences.en: And you can see the P's start to appear by people's names as they vote present.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到当人们投票“出席”时，名字旁边开始出现“P”。

sentences.en: Representatives-elect who have not obtained their voting ID cards may do so now in the Speaker's lobby.
sentences.zh: 尚未获得投票身份证件的候任众议员现在可以在议长休息室领取。

sentences.en: So it was around this time that I snuck in myself to the House press gallery balcony.
sentences.zh: 大约就在这个时候，我溜进了众议院新闻发布厅的阳台。

sentences.en: And I couldn't help noticing how really different the energy and the appearance were on the two sides of the House.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住注意到众议院两边的活力和外观是多么不同。

sentences.en: On the Democratic side, it was youthful and loud and a little kind of chaotic with children running around.
sentences.zh: 在民主党那边，充满活力、喧闹，还有点混乱，孩子们跑来跑去。

sentences.en: And there was kind of this sea of clothing.
sentences.zh: 而且有一种服装的海洋。

sentences.en: There was a Palestinian foe, a Muslim headscarf.
sentences.zh: 有巴勒斯坦风格的服装，有穆斯林头巾。

sentences.en: There was a Pueblo dress.
sentences.zh: 有普韦布洛风格的裙子。

sentences.en: And on the Republican side, by comparison, it was really kind of stark.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，共和党那边确实显得非常冷清。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was pretty striking.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常引人注目。

sentences.en: I mean, I think part of it is just the demographics of the new Democratic class.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为部分原因只是新一届民主党议员的人口构成。

sentences.en: And, you know, the Democratic caucus was already pretty diverse.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，民主党党团会议本身就已经相当多元化了。

sentences.en: But this new infusion of members really made that a lot more pronounced.
sentences.zh: 但这次新加入的成员确实让这种多元化更加显著。

sentences.en: And they made a point today of, like, really strutting that and displaying that well.
sentences.zh: 而且他们今天特意展示了这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, Deb Haaland, who is the first Native American woman in Congress,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，国会第一位美洲原住民女性黛布·哈兰，

sentences.en: made a point of wearing her traditional Pueblo dress with the moccasins and, like, the beautiful turquoise and silver jewelry.
sentences.zh: 特意穿上了她传统的普韦布洛裙子，配上鹿皮软鞋，还有漂亮的绿松石和银饰。

sentences.en: And, you know, she did that because she was making a statement.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她这样做是因为她在表达一种立场。

sentences.en: And, you know, the first Palestinian member wore her, as you mentioned, a thobe.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，正如你提到的，第一位巴勒斯坦裔议员穿了她的长袍。

sentences.en: And again, that's not something she wears every day.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这不是她每天都穿的衣服。

sentences.en: But it's because they wanted to take note of this moment and have the world take note of this moment that, you know, this is different.
sentences.zh: 但这是因为她们想记录这一刻，并让世界注意到这一刻，你知道，这与众不同。

sentences.en: This is a different face of Congress.
sentences.zh: 这是国会的新面貌。

sentences.en: And on the Republican side, it was a lot of men in business suits and ties and women in, like, solid colored, sensible business dresses.
sentences.zh: 而在共和党那边，大多是穿着商务西装和领带的男士，以及穿着纯色、得体商务裙装的女士。

sentences.en: And, you know, the mood, I think, was also just more somber.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为气氛也更加沉闷。

sentences.en: They're losing the majority.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了多数席位。

sentences.en: And they're much less relevant in the current environment of divided government.
sentences.zh: 在当前分裂政府的环境下，他们的重要性大大降低了。

sentences.en: Pursuant to law and precedent, the next order of business is election of the Speaker of the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 根据法律和先例，下一项议程是选举美国众议院议长。

sentences.en: So basically that kind of unfolded for a while until they got to the point where they had enough members present on the floor.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上这种情况持续了一段时间，直到他们议事厅里有足够的议员到场。

sentences.en: Nominations are now in order.
sentences.zh: 现在开始提名。

sentences.en: To actually start the vote.
sentences.zh: 正式开始投票。

sentences.en: The clerk recognizes the gentleman from New York, Mr. Jeffries.
sentences.zh: 书记官认可来自纽约的杰弗里斯先生。

sentences.en: Hakeem Jeffries, who's the head of the Democratic caucus, gets up to make his nominating speech.
sentences.zh: 民主党党团会议主席哈基姆·杰弗里斯起身发表提名演讲。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: For Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 为了南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: A voice for the voiceless.
sentences.zh: 为无声者发声。

sentences.en: A defender of the disenfranchised.
sentences.zh: 为被剥夺权利者辩护。

sentences.en: And it's this, you know, super high energy nomination.
sentences.zh: 这是一场超级充满活力的提名。

sentences.en: And that's why we stand squarely behind her today.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们今天坚定地支持她。

sentences.en: That he ends with saying.
sentences.zh: 他最后说道。

sentences.en: House Democrats are down with NDP.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人支持NDP。

sentences.en: We're down with NDP.
sentences.zh: 我们支持NDP。

sentences.en: This is his initials.
sentences.zh: 这是她的名字缩写。

sentences.en: Pelosi's initials for Speaker.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西的议长缩写。

sentences.en: Speaker of the United States House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 美国众议院议长。

sentences.en: May God bless the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑美利坚合众国。

sentences.en: But everyone goes crazy and it's like, you know, it's very exuberant.
sentences.zh: 但每个人都疯狂了，你知道，非常热情高涨。

sentences.en: The clerk now recognizes the gentlewoman from Wyoming, Ms. Cheney.
sentences.zh: 书记官现在认可来自怀俄明州的切尼女士。

sentences.en: So and then Liz Cheney on the Republican side, who's the head of their conference.
sentences.zh: 然后是共和党那边的利兹·切尼，她是他们党团会议的主席。

sentences.en: To nominate the gentleman from California, Mr. McCarthy, as Speaker of the United States House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 提名来自加利福尼亚州的麦卡锡先生为美国众议院议长。

sentences.en: Gets up and nominates Kevin McCarthy, the congressman from California, who has been the majority leader, is now going to be the minority leader.
sentences.zh: 起身提名加利福尼亚州众议员凯文·麦卡锡，他曾是多数党领袖，现在将成为少数党领袖。

sentences.en: And again, it's a much more sort of somber speech, but, you know, praising his leadership.
sentences.zh: 同样，这更像是一场沉闷的演讲，但你知道，是在赞扬他的领导能力。

sentences.en: Leader McCarthy led us in passing legislation to secure our borders, keep our nation safe and the devastating practice of sanctuary cities.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡领袖带领我们通过了立法，以确保我们的边境安全，保障国家安全，并结束了庇护城市的破坏性做法。

sentences.en: And yes, Madam Clerk, build the wall.
sentences.zh: 是的，书记官女士，修建那堵墙。

sentences.en: With the occasional dig at the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 并偶尔对民主党进行抨击。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: This is her chance to sort of set the table a bit before Pelosi has her moment in the sun.
sentences.zh: 这是她在大佩洛西大放异彩之前，先为自己铺路的机会。

sentences.en: The names of the Honorable Nancy Pelosi, a representative elect from the state of California, and the Honorable Kevin McCarthy, a representative from the state of California,
sentences.zh: 来自加利福尼亚州的当选众议员南希·佩洛西阁下，以及来自加利福尼亚州的众议员凯文·麦卡锡阁下，

sentences.en: have been placed in nomination.
sentences.zh: 已被提名为候选人。

sentences.en: So and then this actual vote gets underway, and it's a very unique kind of vote, because unlike most votes in the House of Representatives, which are tallied electronically.
sentences.zh: 接下来将进行正式投票，这是一种非常独特的投票方式，因为与众议院大多数电子计票的投票不同，

sentences.en: The reading clerk will now call the roll.
sentences.zh: 宣读书记员现在将进行点名。

sentences.en: This is a roll call vote where people actually have to say the name of the person they want to vote for for speaker in turn.
sentences.zh: 这是一次唱名投票，议员们必须依次说出他们想要投票支持的议长人选的名字。

sentences.en: Mr. Abraham.
sentences.zh: 亚伯拉罕先生。

sentences.en: McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡。

sentences.en: And they literally go through every single member of the House alphabetically.
sentences.zh: 他们会按字母顺序逐一叫到众议院的每一位成员。

sentences.en: AdaMs.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯。

sentences.en: Say the member's name.
sentences.zh: 说出议员的名字。

sentences.en: The member says who they vote for.
sentences.zh: 议员说出他们投票支持的对象。

sentences.en: McCarthy or Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡或佩洛西。

sentences.en: Or in some cases, in a few cases, somebody else entirely.
sentences.zh: 或者在某些情况下，极少数情况下，是其他完全不同的人。

sentences.en: You can vote for whoever you want for speaker.
sentences.zh: 你可以投票给任何你想选的议长人选。

sentences.en: McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡。

sentences.en: And then the clerk who's taking the roll repeats the vote back.
sentences.zh: 然后负责点名的书记员会复述一遍投票结果。

sentences.en: Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西。

sentences.en: And some members use their vote to, like, make a little statement, you know.
sentences.zh: 有些议员会利用投票的机会，发表一点小小的声明，你知道的。

sentences.en: I vote for the lady who will truly make America great again.
sentences.zh: 我投票给那位真正能让美国再次伟大的女士。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西。

sentences.en: So who are the Democrats who don't vote for her in this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，在这一刻没有投票给她的民主党人是谁呢？

sentences.en: Spanberger.
sentences.zh: 斯潘伯格。

sentences.en: Bustos.
sentences.zh: 布斯托斯。

sentences.en: You have people like Abigail Spanberger in Virginia, Mikey Sherrill in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 比如弗吉尼亚州的阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格，新泽西州的米基·谢里尔。

sentences.en: Lamb.
sentences.zh: 兰姆。

sentences.en: Connor Lamb, who was elected in a special election earlier in the year, but from Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 康纳·兰姆，他是今年早些时候通过特别选举当选的，来自宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: Brindisi.
sentences.zh: 布林迪西。

sentences.en: Almost all of them are newly elected members who campaigned saying that they wouldn't vote for Nancy Pelosi, that they want to change in Washington.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎都是新当选的议员，在竞选时就曾表示不会投票给南希·佩洛西，他们想要改变华盛顿。

sentences.en: They wanted a new face for their party.
sentences.zh: 他们想要为自己的党派换一张新面孔。

sentences.en: They wanted, you know, the gridlock to end.
sentences.zh: 他们想要结束那种僵局。

sentences.en: And a lot of them are people who ran in districts that Trump won.
sentences.zh: 而且他们很多人是在特朗普获胜的选区竞选的。

sentences.en: They're not in solidly Democratic districts where Nancy Pelosi is going to be an asset.
sentences.zh: 他们所在的选区并非铁杆民主党选区，南希·佩洛西在那里并不会成为加分项。

sentences.en: And many of them are in districts where she is going to be a liability.
sentences.zh: 相反，在很多选区，她反而会成为一种负担。

sentences.en: And so they came in after the election pretty firm in their belief that they couldn't vote for her,
sentences.zh: 所以他们在选举后带着坚定的信念来到这里，认为自己不能投票给她，

sentences.en: both because they didn't feel comfortable doing so and also because they campaigned saying they never would.
sentences.zh: 既是因为他们觉得这样做不舒服，也是因为他们竞选时承诺过绝不会投给她。

sentences.en: So among these closely watched freshmen who just got elected, in the end, it was not the liberal freshmen who opposed her on the floor today.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这些备受关注的新人中，最终在今天议会大厅里反对她的，并不是那些自由派新人。

sentences.en: It was Democrats who feared having an association with her of having to explain to their Trump voting constituents back at home that they had voted for Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 而是那些担心与她产生关联的民主党人，他们担心回家后无法向投票给特朗普的选民解释自己为何投票支持佩洛西。

sentences.en: Those are the ones who lodged protest votes.
sentences.zh: 正是这些人投下了抗议票。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At one point when it's Ocasio-Cortez, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's turn to vote.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，轮到亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯投票时。
zh_words: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: A star House liberal freshman.
sentences.zh: 一位众议院的明星自由派新人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And she's like wearing a stark white suit and bright red lipstick.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一身纯白色的套装，涂着鲜红的口红。

sentences.en: And she's very recognizable.
sentences.zh: 而且她非常有辨识度。

sentences.en: She gets up and she says, Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 她站起来说，南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: And as she's sitting down, the Republicans all sort of a couple of them like boo and do a little bit of hissing.
sentences.zh: 当她坐下时，共和党人中有一部分人发出嘘声，还发出了一些嘶嘶声。

sentences.en: And she kind of smiles and looks over and mouths, sorry.
sentences.zh: 她笑了笑，看向那边，口型说着：抱歉。

sentences.en: You know, they have really hoped that Ocasio-Cortez and the left become as much of a thorn in the side of Nancy Pelosi as a speaker as the Freedom Caucus.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们真的希望奥卡西奥-科尔特斯和左翼能像“自由核心小组”那样，成为南希·佩洛西担任议长时的眼中钉。

sentences.en: And the hard right was for John Boehner and Paul Ryan after him.
sentences.zh: 就像极右翼曾对待约翰·博纳和后来的保罗·瑞安那样。

sentences.en: But in the end, she voted for Pelosi and all the other progressives did.
sentences.zh: 但最终，她投票支持了佩洛西，其他进步派人士也都投了赞成票。

sentences.en: And they had made a pragmatic choice.
sentences.zh: 他们做出了务实的选择。

sentences.en: She went with Pelosi as sort of the most effective alternative if she wants to have a majority that actually does something.
sentences.zh: 她选择了佩洛西，认为如果想要拥有一个真正能有所作为的多数派，这是最有效的替代方案。

sentences.en: Then there's this weird, like, lull where we all know that she's going to be the speaker.
sentences.zh: 然后出现了一段奇怪的间歇，我们都知道她肯定会成为议长。

sentences.en: But there's all this counting going on.
sentences.zh: 但现场一直在进行计票。

sentences.en: And there's, like, backing and forthing.
sentences.zh: 还有各种来回的沟通。

sentences.en: And the clerks at the desks are pouring over their sheets of paper.
sentences.zh: 桌旁的书记员们正在仔细核对他们的纸质表格。

sentences.en: And the tellers on each side are pouring over their sheets of paper.
sentences.zh: 两边的计票员也在仔细核对他们的表格。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of milling around.
sentences.zh: 现场有很多人在走动。

sentences.en: And it takes a while for the announcement to be made by the clerk of the House.
sentences.zh: 众议院书记员宣布结果还需要一段时间。

sentences.en: — The tellers agree in their tallies that the total number of votes cast is 430, of which the Honorable Nancy Pelosi of the state of California has received 220.
sentences.zh: ——计票员一致确认，总投票数为430票，其中来自加利福尼亚州的南希·佩洛西阁下获得了220票。

sentences.en: — That Nancy Pelosi has been elected speaker.
sentences.zh: ——南希·佩洛西已当选议长。

sentences.en: And at that point—
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻——

sentences.en: — And in that spirit, I extend my hand to friendship.
sentences.zh: ——本着这种精神，我伸出友谊之手。

sentences.en: — That is when you have this kind of rare moment of bipartisanship where Kevin McCarthy from the Republican side and Nancy Pelosi from the Democratic side
sentences.zh: ——那是你们所见到的那种罕见的跨党派时刻，来自共和党的凯文·麦卡锡和来自民主党的南希·佩洛西

sentences.en: both go up together to the dais.
sentences.zh: 一起走上主席台。

sentences.en: — And to the Speaker of the House, Nancy Pelosi, I extend to you this gavel.
sentences.zh: ——向众议院议长南希·佩洛西，我将此木槌交给您。

sentences.en: — And he hands her the gavel, and she becomes Speaker of the House.
sentences.zh: ——他把木槌交给她，她便成为了众议院议长。

sentences.en: — And what does she actually say?
sentences.zh: ——她到底说了什么？

sentences.en: — Thank you very much, Leader McCarthy.
sentences.zh: ——非常感谢，麦卡锡领袖。

sentences.en: I look forward to working with you in a bipartisan way.
sentences.zh: 我期待着以跨党派的方式与您合作。

sentences.en: — So she starts out with sort of a gesture to the Republicans.
sentences.zh: ——所以她一开始就向共和党人表达了一种姿态。

sentences.en: — I respect you and the constituents who sent each and every one of us here.
sentences.zh: ——我尊重您，也尊重将我们每一位送来这里的选民。

sentences.en: They expect and deserve for us to try to find our common ground.
sentences.zh: 他们期望并值得我们努力寻找共同点。

sentences.en: — There's a really interesting moment where she mentions dreamers.
sentences.zh: ——有一个非常有趣的时刻，她提到了“梦想生”。

sentences.en: — And we will make America more American by protecting our patriotic, courageous dreamers.
sentences.zh: ——我们将通过保护我们爱国、勇敢的“梦想生”，让美国变得更加美国化。

sentences.en: — Whose protections President Trump has revoked.
sentences.zh: ——他们的保护权已被特朗普总统撤销。

sentences.en: — And when we're talking about the dreamers, let us remember what President Reagan said.
sentences.zh: ——当我们谈论“梦想生”时，让我们记住里根总统说过的话。

sentences.en: — She quotes Ronald Reagan in his final speech as president.
sentences.zh: ——她引用了罗纳德·里根作为总统的最后一次演讲。

sentences.en: — He said, if we ever close the door to new Americans, our leadership role in the world will soon be loSt.
sentences.zh: ——他说，如果我们关闭通往新美国人的大门，我们在世界上的领导地位很快就会丧失。

sentences.en: Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德·里根。

sentences.en: — And there's a big round of applause.
sentences.zh: ——现场响起了一阵热烈的掌声。

sentences.en: — And as I looked out over the chamber, it's all Democrats who are clapping.
sentences.zh: ——当我望向议会大厅时，只有民主党人在鼓掌。

sentences.en: — And so there's a long pause, and she finally looks over to the Republican side and says,
sentences.zh: ——于是出现了长时间的停顿，她最后看向共和党那边说，

sentences.en: — You don't applaud for Ronald Reagan?
sentences.zh: ——你们不为罗纳德·里根鼓掌吗？

sentences.en: — You don't applaud Ronald Reagan?
sentences.zh: ——你们不为罗纳德·里根鼓掌吗？

sentences.en: — Hmm.
— You know, she's trying to reach out and be bipartisan and seem like she's talking to everyone.
sentences.zh: ——你知道，她试图伸出援手，表现出跨党派的姿态，看起来好像在和所有人对话。

sentences.en: But she kind of notes in this wry way that there are limits to that.
sentences.zh: 但她以一种讽刺的方式指出，这种做法是有局限性的。

sentences.en: — I close by remembering a cherished former member of this body.
sentences.zh: ——最后，我想起本机构一位受人尊敬的前成员。

sentences.en: — And this wasn't the only time she mentioned a Republican president.
sentences.zh: ——而且这并不是她唯一一次提到共和党总统。

sentences.en: She actually closed her speech by talking about George H.W.
sentences.zh: 她实际上在演讲结束时谈到了乔治·H·W·布什。

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 布什。

sentences.en: — Today, I single out one of his great achievements, working with both Democrats and Republicans to write the Americans with Disabilities Act into the laws of our land.
sentences.zh: ——今天，我特别提到他的一项伟大成就，即与民主党和共和党人共同努力，将《美国残疾人法案》写入我们的国家法律。

sentences.en: — What's the message of mentioning these Republican presidents?
sentences.zh: ——提到这些共和党总统传达了什么信息？

sentences.en: — Well, I think she's trying to show that, you know, she is respectful of people of both parties, but with a clear kind of sharper edge implied of, like, but she doesn't actually
sentences.zh: ——嗯，我认为她试图表明，你知道，她尊重两党的人，但同时也隐含着一种更尖锐的意味，即她实际上并不

sentences.en: respect the sitting Republican president, you know?
sentences.zh: 尊重现任共和党总统，你懂的？

sentences.en: She's sort of hearkening back to a time when Republicans and Democrats were better able to kind of talk to each other and share some common values and give a nod to the fact
sentences.zh: 她是在回顾一个共和党人和民主党人能够更好地相互交谈、分享共同价值观的时代，并承认

sentences.en: that that's not happening anymore.
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经不再发生了。

sentences.en: — It's a call for a kind of bipartisan spirit that has been lacking, and it certainly wasn't the hallmark of the Republican Congress that just closed.
sentences.zh: ——这是一种对跨党派精神的呼唤，这种精神一直缺失，而且肯定不是刚刚结束的那届共和党国会的标志。

sentences.en: And so I think she's trying to kind of identify Democrats with that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为她试图将民主党与那种精神联系起来。

sentences.en: — But that also sounds like a message to her own new activist liberal House freshmen that would seem to kind of put them in their place and say, your agenda is not our only agenda.
sentences.zh: ——但这听起来也像是对她自己新当选的激进自由派众议院新人的信息，似乎是在告诫他们，你们的议程不是我们唯一的议程。

sentences.en: In fact, it may not even be my agenda.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那甚至可能不是我的议程。

sentences.en: It's one of many agenda that we have to deal with here.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在这里必须处理的众多议程之一。

sentences.en: — I think that's right.
sentences.zh: ——我想你是对的。

sentences.en: And I think that was a big kind of theme of the speech was that, you know, none of this is about being partisan and being on one team or the other.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是演讲的一个重要主题，即这一切都不是为了党派之争，也不是为了站在哪一边。

sentences.en: It's about what the voters told us, which is that we want you to go to Washington and fix things and talk to each other and be more accountable to the people.
sentences.zh: 而是关于选民告诉我们的，那就是我们希望你们去华盛顿解决问题，相互沟通，并对人民更加负责。

sentences.en: And so whatever that means, that's what we're going to need to do.
sentences.zh: 所以无论这意味着什么，这都是我们需要做的。

sentences.en: And it's not going to be about, you know, staking out our positions on the fringes.
sentences.zh: 而且这不应该关乎我们在边缘问题上坚持立场。

sentences.en: Now, in practice, we'll see whether that actually pans out.
sentences.zh: 现在，在实践中，我们将看看这是否真的能实现。

sentences.en: But it is important for, I think, going into her first day as speaker to make it clear to people that she is not going to be carrying the water for any one particular ideological
sentences.zh: 但我认为，在她作为议长的第一天，向人们明确表示她不会为任何特定的意识形态派别效力是很重要的，

sentences.en: part of the spectrum, that she has to unify everyone or else this thing is not going to work.
sentences.zh: 她必须团结所有人，否则这件事就无法运作。

sentences.en: This majority is not going to be effective.
sentences.zh: 这个多数派将无法发挥作用。

sentences.en: — Do you solemnly swear that you will support and defend the Constitution of the United States
sentences.zh: ——你是否庄严宣誓，你将支持和捍卫美利坚合众国宪法，

sentences.en: against all enemies, foreign and domestic, that you will bear true faith and allegiance to the same, that you take this obligation freely without any mental reservation or purpose
sentences.zh: 反对一切国内外敌人，你将对宪法保持真正的信仰和忠诚，你将自由地承担这一义务，没有任何精神保留或逃避的目的，

sentences.en: of evasion, and that you will well and faithfully discharge the duties of the office on which you're about to enter, so I'll help you God.
sentences.zh: 并且你将忠实地履行你即将就任的职务的职责，愿上帝保佑你。

sentences.en: — I do.
sentences.zh: ——我宣誓。

sentences.en: — Congratulations, Madam Speaker.
sentences.zh: ——恭喜你，议长女士。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: ——我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: ——《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: — Um, I could do it now, or I could, I mean, I'm going to be here a long time.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，我现在可以做，或者我可以，我是说，我还要在这里待很长时间。

sentences.en: So, if you want to do it now, I can.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你现在想做，我可以。

sentences.en: I'm not, like, on deadline this second.
sentences.zh: 我并没有在这一秒赶截止日期。

sentences.en: — Let's just do it.
sentences.zh: ——我们就做吧。

sentences.en: I think it could be pretty faSt.
sentences.zh: 我想这应该会很快。

sentences.en: — Let me see if I can grab a chair.
sentences.zh: ——让我看看能不能找把椅子。

sentences.en: — Yeah.
sentences.zh: ——好的。

sentences.en: Okay, here we go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: So, Julia, I was speaking to Senator Schumer yesterday about getting the government open
sentences.zh: 所以，朱莉娅，我昨天和舒默参议员谈过关于让政府重新开门的事，

sentences.en: again, but a lot of our conversation was about what he described as this ironclad partnership
sentences.zh: 但我们谈话的很大一部分是关于他所描述的与佩洛西之间那种坚不可摧的伙伴关系，

sentences.en: with Pelosi to work together, starting with solving the shutdown and making sure to not fund the wall.
sentences.zh: 即共同努力，从解决政府停摆开始，并确保不为边境墙提供资金。

sentences.en: But more broadly, his point was that the two of them are going to be in constant communication.
sentences.zh: 但更广泛地说，他的观点是他们两人将保持持续的沟通。

sentences.en: They're going to be this one unified democratic unit.
sentences.zh: 他们将成为一个统一的民主党整体。

sentences.en: And that's his perspective.
sentences.zh: 这是他的观点。

sentences.en: I wonder what Pelosi's perspective on that partnership is.
sentences.zh: 我想知道佩洛西对这种伙伴关系的看法。

sentences.en: Is it as unified to her, or does she have a different take on the relationship?
sentences.zh: 对她来说是否也同样统一，还是她对这种关系有不同的看法？

sentences.en: — I think it is as unified in her mind, but maybe for different reasons.
sentences.zh: ——我认为在她的心目中也是统一的，但原因可能不同。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that she recognizes the reality that she is the one with the actual majority.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为她认识到这样一个现实：她才是真正拥有多数席位的人。

sentences.en: She's the one who needs to set the table for these votes to take place.
sentences.zh: 她是那个需要为这些投票铺平道路的人。

sentences.en: — And her ability to do that is going to shape the message in a lot of ways that Democrats are going to go forward with.
sentences.zh: ——而她做到这一点能力，将在很大程度上塑造民主党未来前进的信息。

sentences.en: But she doesn't want to be in a position where the House is moving in a direction that Schumer can't follow, because that undercuts her negotiating power.
sentences.zh: 但她不想让自己处于一种被动的境地，即众议院的行动方向是舒默无法跟进的，因为那会削弱她的谈判筹码。

sentences.en: And if nothing else, Nancy Pelosi is a very effective legislative maneuverer, and she knows that your power is in knowing where the votes are.
sentences.zh: 而且如果说南希·佩洛西还有什么特长的话，那就是她是一位非常高效的立法操盘手，她深知权力的关键在于掌握选票的动向。

sentences.en: And that's not only true in terms of the House.
sentences.zh: 这一点不仅适用于众议院。

sentences.en: It's also true in terms of the Senate.
sentences.zh: 在参议院也同样适用。

sentences.en: She has to know that if, you know, she's going to stake out a position and she's going to need Schumer to be able to hold Senate Democrats together on it, that he's going
sentences.zh: 她必须明白，如果她要确立一个立场，并且需要舒默能够让参议院民主党人团结一致支持该立场，那么他必须

sentences.en: to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 有能力做到这一点。

sentences.en: And so for the same reasons, I think that Schumer sees it this way, Pelosi also does.
sentences.zh: 因此，出于同样的原因，我认为舒默是这样看的，佩洛西也是如此。

sentences.en: But she has an added incentive because she doesn't want to make her members take votes that are going to be meaningless in the end.
sentences.zh: 但她还有额外的动力，因为她不想让她的成员们去投那些最终毫无意义的票。

sentences.en: If she can stake out a position that can be sustained by Senate Democrats, it's a much more effective way of messaging and potentially, if they can find issues where they can draw
sentences.zh: 如果她能确立一个能得到参议院民主党人支持的立场，这将是一种更有效的传达信息的方式；而且如果他们能找到一些议题，争取到

sentences.en: a handful of Republicans to their side, a much more effective way of actually getting something done and getting something to President Trump's desk.
sentences.zh: 少数共和党人站在他们这一边，这实际上是达成目标并将其呈交到特朗普总统办公桌上的一种更有效的方式。

sentences.en: So she really does need Schumer as much as Schumer needs her.
sentences.zh: 所以她确实需要舒默，就像舒默需要她一样。

sentences.en: We think in this moment of Schumer needing Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 我们认为在当下这个时刻，是舒默需要南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: I do, at least, because she actually has a legislative majority.
sentences.zh: 至少我是这么认为的，因为她确实拥有立法多数席位。

sentences.en: But it sounds like she also needs him and the Senate Democrats in order for that majority to be effective and for its votes to carry actual meaning.
sentences.zh: 但听起来她也需要他以及参议院民主党人，才能让这个多数优势发挥作用，并让其投票具有实际意义。

sentences.en: To some degree.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, there are going to be places where she is going to have to part ways with him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某些地方她将不得不与他分道扬镳。

sentences.en: Schumer has a much more sort of moderate caucus.
sentences.zh: 舒默的党团会议成员构成要温和得多。

sentences.en: If you look at the group of Democrats that he has, it's a much simpler sort of math problem for him.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看他手下的那群民主党人，对他来说这是一个简单得多的数学问题。

sentences.en: And so she can't let him drag her too far to the right because then her progressives will revolt and they'll say, why are we going to the right?
sentences.zh: 所以她不能让他把她拉得太靠右，因为那样她的进步派成员就会反抗，他们会问，我们为什么要向右转？

sentences.en: We're the majority.
sentences.zh: 我们才是多数派。

sentences.en: We should be as progressive as we want to be.
sentences.zh: 我们应该尽可能地保持我们想要的进步立场。

sentences.en: We should be as, you know, dug in on our position as we want to be.
sentences.zh: 我们应该尽可能地坚持我们想要的立场。

sentences.en: And that's not always going to be the incentive for Schumer.
sentences.zh: 而这对舒默来说并不总是动力所在。

sentences.en: But on something like government shutdown, where there's a lot of unity among Democrats, I don't think you're going to see a lot of daylight between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 但在政府停摆这类问题上，民主党内部非常团结，我认为你不会看到他们两人之间有太大的分歧。

sentences.en: They're most effective when they can be in lockstep.
sentences.zh: 当他们步调一致时，他们最有效率。

sentences.en: There seems to be greater risk for her in the relationship and then the concept of the two of them being in lockstep than for him because of the diversity
sentences.zh: 对于她来说，这种关系以及两人步调一致的概念似乎比对他来说风险更大，因为

sentences.en: ideologically of the House Democratic caucus.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党党团在意识形态上的多样性。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想你说得对。

sentences.en: She has members who will give her more trouble and she has more loose because she's in the majority.
sentences.zh: 她手下有一些会给她制造更多麻烦的成员，而且因为她是多数党领袖，她有更多需要顾及的地方。

sentences.en: You know, she's shooting with live bullets.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她现在是在动真格的。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Chuck Schumer has a different problem, which is he has a bunch of people in his caucus
sentences.zh: 另一方面，查克·舒默有另一个问题，那就是他的党团里有一群人

sentences.en: in the Senate who are eyeing runs for the presidency, who are not going to want to let
sentences.zh: 在参议院里，他们正盯着总统大选，他们不想让

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi and the House Democrats be to the left of them, who are going to want to be defining that ground that Democrats are going to be on.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西和众议院民主党人站在他们的左翼，他们想要定义民主党人所处的立场。

sentences.en: And so they have different probleMs. But I think when it comes to being outward facing toward Republicans, they both
sentences.zh: 所以他们有不同的问题。但我认为当面对共和党人时，他们都

sentences.en: see the need to be unified because if Pelosi is going to be successful, she needs Schumer to be able to sustain her positions in the Senate and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 看到了团结的必要性，因为如果佩洛西想要成功，她需要舒默能够在参议院支持她的立场，反之亦然。

sentences.en: So with all this in mind and taking stock of this day, what is the meaning of what happened here in the Capitol today?
sentences.zh: 那么，考虑到这一切，回顾今天，今天在国会大厦发生的事情意味着什么？

sentences.en: I think what you saw was this sort of very different looking, different sounding, energized majority of Democrats and Speaker Pelosi sort of trying to reset the conversation a bit
sentences.zh: 我认为你所看到的是一种看起来非常不同、听起来也非常不同、充满活力的民主党多数派，以及佩洛西议长试图稍微重置对话，

sentences.en: and reimagine what Congress can be about after two years of having a Congress that never told the president, no, always had his back, was always in lockstep with what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 并重新构想国会可以做些什么。在过去的两年里，国会从未对总统说不，总是支持他，总是与他的行动步调一致。

sentences.en: This was an attempt to kind of turn the page and say, we look different, we sound different,
sentences.zh: 这是一种试图翻开新篇章的尝试，意思是，我们看起来不同，听起来不同，

sentences.en: we are going to be different, but we're going to try to do it in a way that sounds unifying.
sentences.zh: 我们将会有所不同，但我们会尝试以一种听起来团结的方式来做到这一点。

sentences.en: So the substance of it is we're challenging President Trump, but the symbolism of it is a more unifying approach.
sentences.zh: 所以其实质是在挑战特朗普总统，但其象征意义是一种更团结的方法。

sentences.en: And honestly, I'll be interested to see how long that lasts because this is going to get messy really faSt. And the shutdown is just sort of the first iteration of that.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我很想看看这能持续多久，因为事情很快就会变得混乱。而政府停摆只是其中的第一个阶段。

sentences.en: So I think it's, it was about a fleeting moment of having a sort of a higher aspiration for
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这只是关于对国会抱有更高期望的短暂时刻。

sentences.en: Congress.
sentences.zh: 我们拭目以待它能否持久。

sentences.en: And we'll see if that lasts.
